Subject: Intro + Demo: Redwood Inference — CIO briefing & scheduling for Frostline

Hi Elena,

Thanks for taking a first pass — I’m Karthik on the Redwood Inference sales team. We’d love to run a short, technical briefing for Tom (CIO) to show how Redwood can reduce inference latency and cost for Frostline’s document-processing pipeline.

Quick proposal: 45-minute live demo + 10-minute Q&A. Suggested windows (PT):
- Tue 2026-09-14, 09:00–09:45
- Wed 2026-09-15, 16:00–16:45

Goals for the session:
- CTO/CIO-level overview (10 min)
- Live demo of a 5–10k token pipeline with latency and cost breakdown (25 min)
- Integration/operational questions + next steps (10 min)

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (brief), soc2-summary.pdf (high-level security pack). I can also share our SOC 2 folder if procurement needs artifacts.

If those slots don’t work, tell me Tom’s availability window and I’ll coordinate. Also: do you prefer a short pre-brief (10–15m) with Tom + one of our engineers before the demo?

Thanks — happy to be flexible.

—
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0136
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)

- Tom's availability is limited the week of Sep 14; he has a 60% open window on Tue morning PT only (09:15–10:15).
- We’d like the demo to be focused to 45 minutes — the latency/cost breakdown is most important.
- Procurement will want SOC 2 artifacts and a short vendor questionnaire. I’ve looped in Maya (procurement).

Can you confirm you can do Tue 9/14, start at 09:15 PT, and whether you can provide the SOC 2 folder link and the high-level runbook ahead of the demo? Also please send who will present the technical portion.

Thanks — I’ll hold a tentative calendar but need confirmation soon.

Best,

I’ll send a calendar invite with the recording toggle off by default; if Frostline needs recording, let me know.
